decisions.statement: An empty body text reads as no error type.
A body text that is no JSON reads as no error type.
An error type is read at `error.type` and nowhere else.
A non-string value at `error.type` reads as no error type.
An empty string at `error.type` is returned as an empty string.
A body key beside `error` never refuses the parse.
Nothing here tells an unparseable body from a body naming no error type.
An `error` key present only on `Object.prototype` reads as absent.

definition: the type an error response body names under the body's `error` key
